decision.summary: A single candidate temporary offset is identified in the U axis (indices 580–585), marked by a sharp, deep negative spike with weak correlated N/E responses. The event lacks a clear opposing return within the allowed context [540,620]; U recovers partially after 585 but does not revert to pre-event baseline before 620. Hence status is uncertain. The second region mentioned in scanning_summary (610–635) lies outside allowed_context (ends at 620), so it is excluded.
